title: Write your own loop
heading: Make a travelling jump loop.
description: Use what you learned with the robot to write a loop for the fox. Replace pass with a loop that repeats a move followed by a jump three times. Both actions should repeat together. Run and count each action.

scene.label: Your character in a meadow. Run your instructions to make it act.

placeholder: Type fox. to discover its actions

feedback.initial: Write a for loop with range(3). Put fox.move() and fox.jump() on separate indented lines. Revisit the robot loop if you need an example.
feedback.success: Did you see three moves and three jumps? Try putting the jump after the loop, without indentation. Predict how many times it will happen now.
